qc.label_under_test: 'the' after a copula that introduces a unique-rank identity ('X is the capital / third-largest / first …', 'will be the death of'), versus 'the' after ordinary action verbs

neighbours.label: 'the' after a copula that introduces a unique-rank identity ('X is the capital / third-largest / first …', 'will be the death of'), versus 'the' after ordinary action verbs
fire: Canberra is the capital of Australia and its seat of law.
For years the plant was the largest employer in the county.
By 1900 Hamburg became the busiest harbour in Germany.
Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth.
That drink will be the death of me.
Frankly, this shop is the cheapest place in town.
On her trip, Rome was the last stop.
Today Houston is the fourth-largest city in the country.
quiet: Canberra is a city in Australia with many offices.
For years the plant was a small employer in the county.
By 1900 Hamburg had the harbour rebuilt in Germany.
Everest is a tall mountain on the border.
That drink will be on me.
Frankly, this shop is cheap, and the staff are kind.
On her trip, Rome was hot and crowded.
Today Houston is hot, and the streets are wet.
